hero.h1: Towing in Brooklyn Park, MN — Cars, SUVs & Light Trucks
hero.subtitulo: Broke down, had an accident or need your car moved? Jump Towing is a local Brooklyn Park towing company serving the northwest metro.
hero.form_nota: Tell us where you are, the vehicle and where it needs to go.

confianza.texto: A local towing company, not a call center

incluye.intro: Light-duty towing for the vehicles people drive every day.

items.texto: Car won't start or quit on the road? We tow it to your shop, your home or a dealer in the area.
After a fender bender we move the vehicle off the street and to the body shop you choose.
Vehicle that doesn't run, a car you bought or one that needs to reach a mechanic: we move cars, SUVs and light trucks.

por_que.h2: Why Call a Local Brooklyn Park Tow Company

items.texto: Many towing sites you see online are lead resellers with no local address. Jump Towing is based in Brooklyn Park.
We work with cars, SUVs and light trucks, the vehicles our trucks are set up for.
Open Monday to Friday 6 AM–6 PM and Saturday 6 AM–3:30 PM, so you know when someone will pick up.

pasos.texto: Tell us where you are, the vehicle and where it needs to go.
Location, vehicle and where it needs to go, so the right truck heads your way.
Your vehicle goes where you need it: shop, home or dealer.

zona.texto: We cover about 10 miles around Brooklyn Park:

items.q: What areas do you tow in?
items.a: Brooklyn Park and about 10 miles around it, including Brooklyn Center, Maple Grove, Plymouth, Coon Rapids, Crystal, New Hope, Robbinsdale, Osseo, Champlin, Fridley and north Minneapolis.
Cars, SUVs and light trucks. We don't do heavy-duty towing for semis, buses or box trucks.
Monday to Friday 6 AM to 6 PM and Saturday 6 AM to 3:30 PM. We're closed on Sundays.

items.q: How much does a tow cost?
items.a: It depends on the vehicle and the distance. Call with your location and destination to get a quote.

items.q: Where can you take my car?
items.a: To your mechanic, a body shop, a dealer or your home within our service area.

cta_final.h2: Need a Tow in Brooklyn Park?
cta_final.texto: Call Jump Towing and tell us where you are.

gracias.texto: We'll call you back during business hours. If you need a tow right now, call us.

pasos.texto: We look at your location and vehicle details.
During business hours: Mon–Fri 6 AM–6 PM, Sat 6 AM–3:30 PM.
